subject: Pilot roadmap, acceptance gates, and ownership — proposed timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@pathwaysys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot roadmap, acceptance gates, and ownership — proposed timeline

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align schedules and responsibilities before kickoff.

Recap (from today)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference throughput and latency for Pathway’s document search pipeline and measure cost-per-query at typical traffic patterns.
- Primary success criteria (high level):
  - 95p latency under 200ms for 2k concurrent req/s synthetic load (acceptance threshold),
  - Top-5 retrieval precision >= 0.78 on the shared eval set,
  - End-to-end cost per 1k queries <= $X (TBD after baseline run).

Proposed pilot timeline (suggested)
- Week 0 (prep): share test data subset, access roles, and completed security questionnaire (due 1 week before kickoff).
- Week 1 (kickoff): 1-hour kickoff — environment access, data ingestion, baseline smoke tests.
- Weeks 2–4: active testing — two weekly checkpoints (Wed mornings PT), run throughput and accuracy experiments.
- Week 5: readout — consolidated results, cost analysis, and recommendation for next steps (scale vs prod).

Ownership (Redwood / Pathway)
- Redwood AE / Project lead: Marcus Lin (I’ll run the cadence and unblock contracts).
- Redwood SE (workstream lead): Marissa Cole — responsible for model onboarding and test harness.
- Customer CS / Integration lead: Jonas Weber (cc’d) will support rollout recommendations.
- Pathway leads: Sophie (product) + Arjun (platform/security).

Immediate asks for kickoff prep
1) Sophie/Arjun — can you confirm test data subset availability and an internal point of contact for credentials?
2) Please complete the security checklist (I attached the minimal FAQ) and confirm any compliance blockers.
3) Suggest two candidate kickoff slots (week of Aug 2) — we proposed Wed/Thu mornings PT.

Attachments: poc-eval-plan-v1.xlsx (evaluation plan), mutual-action-plan.docx (MOU-lite), redwood-security-faq.pdf (short answers).

If this looks right I’ll lock in a kickoff invite and share an edited mutual action plan with milestone dates.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@pathwaysys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@pathwaysys.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot roadmap, acceptance gates, and ownership — proposed timeline

Thanks Marcus — this is really helpful and matches our internal notes. A few clarifications and small asks from our side:

- Success criteria: the precision metric should be measured against our labeled subset (we’ll share the file). Can we add a secondary metric for recall@10? That’s important for downstream ranking.
- Timeline: week of Aug 2 works. Could we aim for kickoff on Tue Aug 3 at 10:00 AM PT instead of Wed? Our infra team has a maintenance window Wed morning.
- Security: I’ve looped in Arjun (platform) — he’ll validate the security FAQ and send any additional requirements.

Action items from Pathway: Sophie will send labeled eval set and two candidate IAM contacts by EOD Jul 22. Arjun — can you confirm whether we need a VPN or if token-based access is sufficient?

We’re excited to move forward — once you confirm the revised kickoff slot I’ll ensure our product and infra leads attend.

Best,
Sophie
Product Manager, Pathway Systems
sophie@pathwaysys.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@pathwaysys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot roadmap, acceptance gates, and ownership — proposed timeline

Appreciate the quick reply, Sophie — Tue Aug 3 10:00 AM PT is fine. I updated the draft timeline and mutual action plan (attached). Notes and clarifications below:

- Additional metric: added recall@10 as a secondary metric in the evaluation sheet; we’ll compute both after the baseline run.
- IAM / access: Jonas — for onboarding we typically offer token-based service accounts and short-lived keys; VPN only needed for air-gapped customers. Jonas, can you confirm minimal steps for Pathway infra?
- Kickoff agenda (30–45 min): introductions, scope review, data ingestion approach, baseline smoke test, quick run of the eval harness. Follow-ups: schedule deep tuning sprints if needed.

Please find attachments: poc-eval-plan-v1.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx (turns dates into owned deliverables), redwood-security-faq.pdf.

Next steps (for Marcus/Pathway)
- I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue Aug 3 10:00 AM PT after I hear back from Jonas on access notes.
- Sophie/Arjun: please confirm the IAM point of contact and share the labeled eval set by Jul 30.

Thanks — Marcus

Hi all — quick security/access confirmation from Pathway infra:

- Token-based short-lived service accounts are acceptable; we do not need VPN for this pilot.
- I’ve attached a small list of IP ranges we will allow (send separately via our SRE ticket), and the team requested a read-only ingest user for the test dataset.
- We received the mutual action plan draft — Sophie, Marcus: please add the target date for the final readout (we suggest Sep 4 to give team availability).

We’ll aim to deliver the labeled eval set and point-person for IAM by Jul 30 as discussed. Looking forward to the kickoff on Aug 3.

Regards,
Arjun Patel
Director of Platform, Pathway Systems
arjun.patel@pathwaysys.com
